extracted.name: Kimchi Brown Rice Bliss Bowls
extracted.description: These healthy vegan kimchi bowls are so delicious and fun to eat! If you're making them ahead, save the avocado to add at the last minute.
ingredient_lines: ½ cup thinly sliced red cabbage
instruction_lines: Assemble the bowls with the rice, kimchi, cucumber, cabbage, avocado, and tempeh.

Drizzle a generous amount of peanut sauce on top and sprinkle with sesame seeds and Thai chiles, if using. Serve with lime slices and remaining peanut sauce on the side. Garnish with microgreens, if desired.
